## Pre-Packaged Learning Materials

These courses and workshops contain curated collections of tutorials designed for specific programs and teaching contexts at TU Delft.

### Available Courses

Browse our workshop materials below, or use the search above to find specific courses. Each workshop page contains:

- Learning objectives
- Required software and data
- Step-by-step tutorials
- Assignments and exercises
- Additional resources

---

### For Instructors

Want to create your own workshop collection? Check out our [Contribute](../contribute.qmd) page to learn how to package tutorials for your students.
